summary: Hockey Shootout (Mini 3) - both backend and frontend fully verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass for POST /api/players/{id}/hockey-shootout - {6}->60, {0}->0, {10}->100, {15}->100 (clamped), {-3}->0 (clamped), missing body->0, unknown player->404, accumulation across calls (30+70=100), and coin delta persists in DB. Frontend /hockey-shootout: header 'MINI 3', 'Shot 1 / 10' counter, '🥅 0' goal counter, shot-timer testID with shrinking width (51.98% -> 20% over 1.5s), Flyers-uniformed goalie moves (samples: 68 -> 36.5 -> 33.5 -> 65 -> 92 -> 123.5 - bounces at bounds), 10 auto-shots via 5s timer expiry completed the game in ~65s, result screen (testID hockey-result) shows 'SHOOTOUT DONE! +50 🪙 5 / 10 GOALS' - NO win/lose framing, coin pill matches goals*10, hockey-continue navigates to /level-map, coin balance server-side went 100 -> 150 (+50 for 5 goals), matching displayed pill exactly. cooking-result trigger logic reviewed in code: L8 win -> /hockey-shootout with 'Mini 3: Hockey Shootout' banner; L3 -> /jersey-math; L6 -> /eagles-match; L12 -> /eagles-flip; others -> /level-map. Iteration 17 - feature complete, no defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: hockey-shootout.tsx useCallback for finish() lists puckAnim as dep but doesn't use it - harmless.
Minor: onFieldLayout uses fieldRef.current.w > 0 early-return, so if the field ever resizes (rotation, keyboard) bounds won't update. Acceptable for a mobile-locked 10-shot flow.
The Animated puck uses useNativeDriver:true which triggers a web-only warning ('RCTAnimation module missing') but falls back to JS animation and works correctly - not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Two anonymous TEST_ prefixed players created via POST /api/players for FE flow (starting coins=100, ended at 150 after 5 goals).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hockey shootout backend+FE verified iter17. Player storage AsyncStorage key on web is 'philly_fare_player_id' via localStorage. For FE regression, seed localStorage before navigating to /hockey-shootout. To drive the game deterministically, do NOT interact with the puck - each 5s timer expires and auto-launches, completing all 10 shots in ~65s.
